topic: Police Station Surveillance Transparency and Digital Evidence Bill

findings.title: Paramvir Singh Saini v. Baljit Singh (2021) 1 SCC 184
findings.limitations: Supreme Court directives mandating night-vision audio CCTV coverage across all areas of all police stations with 18-month retention.

gaps: Absence of statutory invalidation rules for arrests/searches conducted during un-explicated CCTV outages.
